description: This PHP source file defines the KpiDao class, which extends the BaseDao class. It provides data access methods for handling KPI entities in the OrangeHRM performance module, including create, retrieve, update, delete operations, and some specific queries related to KPIs.

classes.name: KpiDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for KPI entities within the OrangeHRM performance module, offering CRUD operations, querying, and utility methods for managing KPI data.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Persists a Kpi entity to the database and returns the entity.

methods.name: getKpiById
methods.description: Retrieves a Kpi entity by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingKpiIds
methods.description: Fetches existing KPI IDs from a list of IDs that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getKpiList
methods.description: Returns a list of KPIs filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getKpiCount
methods.description: Returns the count of KPIs matching specific search criteria.

methods.name: getKpiQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a query builder wrapper for KPI queries with optional filtering by job title.

methods.name: getDefaultKpi
methods.description: Returns the default KPI, if set.

methods.name: deleteKpi
methods.description: Marks specific KPIs as deleted after checking whether they are associated with any active performance reviews.

methods.name: unsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Removes the default KPI designation from all KPIs except optionally one specified by ID.

methods.name: isKpiEditable
methods.description: Checks whether a KPI is editable based on if it has been referenced in any activated reviewer ratings.

methods.name: isKpiDeletable
methods.description: Checks whether a KPI can be deleted based on if it is referenced in any inactive reviewer ratings.
